text:
Amelia: Quick sync — noticed a ~22% drop from invite accept -> first session in last DP cohort. Proposing a small micro-experiment to test two lightweight onboarding flows (email copy + simplify setup). Goal: unblock recruitment friction fast. Thoughts?
Sam: Sounds good. Can we target high-intent partners first (those with integrations + signed NDA)? lower noise.
Jordan: +1. I can mock a ‘lite’ onboarding flow that hides advanced setup until later. Want a fallback tooltip for power users.
Matt: Backend work looks small: add feature flag + event + metric. Est ~2d dev + 1d test. Need a signal spec for what to instrument.
Leah: I’ll do a quick power calc. Baseline conv=22%. If we want a practically meaningful lift, what are we shooting for? +10–12pp?
Amelia: Suggest success criteria: +12 percentage points absolute to first session, p<0.05, and no increase in support tickets >5%. Secondary: 7-day retention lift.
Sam: Also require no negative impact on activation time >15s or average completion time. If we get a short-term bump but retention drops, deprioritize.
Jordan: Posting prototype link (private): https://redwood.app/ux/onboard-lite — will iterate.
Matt: Minimal experiment flag plan: 
```
feature_flag: beta_onboard_v2
metrics: invite -> accepted -> first_session_event
variant: control (current), variant_a (lite email), variant_b (lite email + simplified setup)
```
Leah: Power calc: baseline 0.22, target 0.34 (12pp). n_per_arm ≈ 482 -> round to 500. With current invite rate ~180/day, reach in ~6 days per arm (~2 weeks for both).
Amelia: Roll plan: dev -> internal canary -> run 2-week A/B -> evaluate -> decide rollout. Owners: Matt infra, Jordan UX, Leah analysis, Sam segmentation, Amelia PM.
Sam: I’ll prepare the invite cohort (filters: integrations=true, NDA=true, no previous DP in last 6mo) and upload csv by EOD tomorrow.
Leah: Analysis plan: pre-register primary metric (first_session boolean, ITT), secondary metrics (7d retention, time-to-first-session), and safety checks (support tickets, error rates). I’ll share a notebook and thresholds.
Amelia: Launch checklist (must-haves before starting): 1) instrumentation validated in staging + logs; 2) experiment flag live and variant rollout script; 3) sample size target and estimated end date; 4) monitoring dashboard and alert on error spikes; 5) plan for qualitative feedback from 20 partners.
Jordan: I’ll schedule 10 usability check-ins across the run to capture qualitative notes.
Matt: Opening PR for flags + metrics: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5678. Estimate deploy can go out tomorrow morning after review.
Sam: :thumbsup:
beta-bot: experiment created: EXP-2026-42, start_ts=1712349996, variants=3.
Amelia: Thanks — if there are no blockers we’ll start the canary tomorrow and then flip experiment once staging looks good. I’ll update the DP playbook with the experiment plan and welcome any last-minute scope cuts.
Matt: Noted, starting work today.
Leah: I’ll post the sample-size calc + significance assumptions in the analysis doc later today.
Sam: I’ll share the invite cohort csv in #product-ops when ready.
Amelia: Closing this sync — owners listed above. Re-open here if you hit any blockers. :rocket:
